_notes: How the App draws the map. Not game tuning; Core ignores it. Two views (DECISIONS D-016): isometric (normal, Tropico style) and topDown (building view). defaultView = view the game opens in. autoTopDownWhilePlacing = flip to topDown while placing/moving, then back. switchFadeSeconds = fade between views. outsideMapColor = color around the map. Per view: tileWidthPt/tileHeightPt = screen points per tile (iso is a 2:1 diamond); artNamespace = folder in App/Assets.xcassets/Art/ (tools/import_art.py --view); facings / turretFacings = 1 (rotate one image) or 4/8 facing images named <id>_e, _se, _s, _sw, _w, _nw, _n, _ne; minScale/startScale = closest and opening camera zoom (bigger = farther out); placeholderHeightTiles = placeholder block height per building category in tile heights (iso only); assets.<artId> = optional fixes: anchor [x, y] = ground point as fractions from the image's top-left (iso default [0.5, 1.0], bottom middle), scale = size multiplier, mirrorable = false to forbid mirroring.
